claim_boundary: All questions were generated in H4 and are outcome-exposed. Results may select and fix an H5 mechanism, but may not be counted as H5 calibration, holdout, certification, or confirmatory evidence.

one_look_mechanism_selection_gate.rule: Evaluate once after all 4,000 generations. No threshold or policy tuning from this pilot. Failure makes this mechanism H5 NO-GO; another repair requires a new development-pilot revision.

repair_hypothesis: H4 called an instruction-tuned causal model with unframed bare text. Native chat serialization plus a bounded check/answer/end contract should prevent continuation loops, preserve short task-relevant reasoning, distinguish natural completion from truncation, and move the C1 safety/utility frontier.

Final answer: <number>
<END>
